title: Time-domain Love numbers

source.citation: Spada, G. et al. (2011). Geophysical Journal International 185(1), 106-132.

what_to_compute: Compute Heaviside Love numbers directly in the time domain, for a significant number of degrees between 2 and 256. Intended for methods that are not based on viscoelastic normal modes.

reference_data.$comment: Contributor abbreviations are those of the paper's table 1. Which files hold which quantity is recorded in docs/reference/column-layouts.qmd, and is not yet decoded for every file.
